summary: Iteration 8: Fully verified the 4 new features — (1) Emergent Google login gate + session, (2) OSM interactive map, (3) Employer anonymization + in-app chat with 3s polling, (4) Category chips on employer leads. Backend: 66/66 pytest green (100%) including 24 new tests for /api/auth/me, /api/chats*, /api/map/pins, and anonymized /api/jobs. Frontend (mobile 390x844): all 7 requested flows PASS — (a) login gate shows login-google-btn when logged out; setting workhop_session_token='test_token_workhop_e2e' + reload shows user-row with 'Test User' + logout-btn; logout returns to gate; (b) employer screen shows OSM iframe, category chips (lead-chip-tech reduces 50→12 leads), employer-inbox-btn opens APPLICANT INBOX (21 threads), map-expand-btn navigates to /map showing 50 pros · 14 hiring companies with ALL/PROS/EMPLOYERS filter chips and legend; (c) FULL CHAT E2E: pre-verified freelancer (via API, seeded in localStorage) opens jobs feed (200 gigs, only company_name + area shown, ZERO phone numbers in DOM) → apply → success flash 'APPLIED · Chat thread opened' + MESSAGE EMPLOYER NOW button → chat opens showing LedgerLite header + privacy notice → freelancer message sent → /employer/inbox lists the thread → open thread as employer (sees freelancer name TEST_ChatUIE2E) → reply sent → freelancer view reloaded shows employer reply within ~3s polling window; (d) jobs feed topbar has jobs-map-btn and jobs-chats-btn; applied cards show job-message-btn-0 that opens the chat; (e) /freelancer/chats lists LedgerLite thread with last-message preview and opens on click. Anonymization audit: NO phone numbers found in jobs feed body text; jobs API responses contain neither employer_name nor employer_phone. Razorpay ₹199 employer checkout still loads correctly (iteration 7 confirmed full unlock path). No blocking issues. Only console noise: known React 19 element.ref warning from @gorhom/bottom-sheet.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking React 19 warning: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19'. Emitted by bottom-sheet in /app/frontend/app/employer/index.tsx and /app/frontend/app/freelancer/jobs.tsx. Known upstream; safe to ignore per task note.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1021 lines with 6 feature domains (leads, freelancer, jobs, quota, plans, auth, chat, map). Recommend splitting into APIRouter modules (auth_router, chat_router, map_router, jobs_router) before next feature to keep <700 lines per file.
freelancer/jobs.tsx has grown to 1111 lines; consider extracting the ApplySheet + PaywallSheet bottom sheet UI into src/components to isolate. Not urgent.

Chat polling in /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx uses 3s setInterval — verified working. For production, consider swapping to server-sent events or websocket to reduce polling load once user count grows.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via {'_id': 0} projection in all chat/conversation/user reads (server.py). Good.

The Emergent OAuth login gate on landing correctly hides all app routes behind AuthProvider — /freelancer/jobs, /employer, /map, /chat all remain reachable ONLY after auth (verified by re-testing with cleared token).
